lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li₂Sb₂S₄ (reduced formula LiSbS₂) adopts the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li and Sb each coordinated by three S neighbors, while S is tetrahedrally coordinated by one Li and three Sb. Corner- and edge-sharing relations are observed among S tetrahedra and between S and Li polyhedra; the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites.
